data.text:
G.Vijayakumar vs Designated Officer on 18 April, 2024 
 Crl.O.P.(MD)
 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court
 Dated: 18.04.2024 
 Coram:
 The Honourable Mr.Justice A.A.Nakkiran
 Crl.O.P.(MD) No.23104 of 2022
 and
 Crl.M.P.(MD).Nos.16391 & 16392 of 2022
 G.Vijayakumar ... Petitioner / Accused 
 Vs.
 Designated Officer,
 Code No.24-012,
 Food Safety and Drug Administration Department,
 Madurai District. 
 ... Respondent/Complainant
 Prayer:  Criminal Original Petition is filed under Section 482 of  Cr.P.C, to call for the records and quash the proceedings in S.T.C.
 1231 of 2021 on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Melur,
 as the petitioner/A1 is concerned.
 For petitioner : Mr.M.Rajaraman  ORDER This petition has been filed to quash the proceedings in S.T.C.No. 1231 of 2021 on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate, Melur. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD)No.23104 of 2022 2.When the matter is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that during the pendency of this petition, the petitioner /accused namely, G.Vijayakumar died and as such, there is no purpose in proceeding with the petition. He has also filed a memo dated 18.04.2024 to that effect. 
3.Recording the said submission, this Criminal Original Petition is dismissed as abated. 
Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
